properties.name: An export carries the branch, commit and dirtiness of the tree it was taken in, and the gate refuses one about to be committed on a branch it was not taken on
properties.rationale: Anthony's 2026-08-31 idea asked for a git coordinate on every node; the record bounded it — a node cannot carry the commit that contains it, the core does no I/O so any coordinate is a caller's claim, and a hand-maintained per-node field goes stale on the first merge — and named the export as the grain at which the measured incident (four phantom drifts that would have merged cleanly, because the graph does not branch with git) was actually a question. On his word 2026-09-16 the export carries it (option ②) and the gate reads it for the one case that is a defect (option ⑤, narrowed): an export taken elsewhere and about to be committed here. A committed export is deliberately not re-judged, because squash merges make the branch name it carries meaningless once it lands — an ancestor check was considered and rejected for exactly that reason. CORRECTED THE CAUSE: for the phantom-drift shape, yes, at the moment it can still be stopped; the per-node traceability he first asked for is not built, and the decision says so.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: THE DOCUMENT (reflow2-core export.rs): GraphExport gains `taken_at: Option<TakenAt>` — branch (None on a detached HEAD), commit, dirty — serde-default so an older document reads with None, skipped when absent, and excluded from the content hash; the three struct literals (export, mirror, merge) set it None, and TakenAt is re-exported from the crate. THE WRITER (reflow2-mcp): git::taken_at reads `rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD`, `rev-parse HEAD` and `status --porcelain` minus the export file itself; export_write::chain_and_write stamps it on every write, keeping the predecessor's coordinate when the design content is unchanged so the bytes stay identical and `wrote: unchanged` stays true; the export_graph receipt carries `taken_at` and the tool's description names it (trimmed to stay under the 1500-char budget; toolsnap updated). THE GATE (tools/reflow2_check.py): check_taken_on_this_branch fails a MODIFIED export whose recorded branch is not the branch checked out (PHANTOM, exit 1) and skips a committed one, a detached HEAD, a missing coordinate, or a tree outside git. Tests: an_export_says_where_it_was_taken.rs (4, document contract), an_export_says_which_tree_it_was_taken_in.rs (4, real git repo: branch+HEAD on receipt and file, dirty excludes the export, unchanged content keeps its coordinate byte-for-byte across a commit, outside git nothing), test_reflow2_check.py TakenOnThisBranch (4). Chain, record-moved, auto-export and the whole gate suite (46) still green.
